summary: Eric W. Summers, 43, of Brighton, drowned while kayaking the Arkansas River; witnesses found him floating face-down behind an unoccupied kayak between Fisherman's Bridge and Browns Canyon (~8 mi south of Buena Vista); autopsy determined drowning
location: Arkansas River between Fisherman's Bridge and Browns Canyon (~8 mi south of Buena Vista)
notes: Mountain Mail 2014 season roundup parent-opened this run; sixth accident, 'July 12'.
